issues.finding: The complete 231-suit managed catalogue audit reports exactly one failing manifest: Devil Spider's preserved repeat atlas, 1024 by 6144 pixels, exceeds SuitManifest's 4096 limit. All 231 native actor containers pass; 230 manifests decode and map their materials. Devil Spider passes offline conversion checks but is not yet loadable through its manifest. Batch representative gameplay does not cover this failure.
issues.next: Support the authored repeat texture through the actual host texture path with bounded memory and GPU-size validation, preserve source RGB/alpha, and prove this suit loads and renders in game.

issues.finding: Gwenom and Venom now retain both authored material slots and every original triangle. Both repaired assets passed full structural and 4196-frame animation tests, 115-frame web tests, exact texture and finger-policy checks, managed loading and individually reviewed native swing/grounded captures. Originals were hash-checked and fully backed up before replacement.
issues.resolution: Installed current per-material conversions. The material repair does not accept visual fist closure, source shader equivalence or tongue appearance in rear-view captures.

issues.finding: Poison's distal tongue hook is corrected with a pose-only rotation. Source bind matrices, hierarchy, weights and chain lengths are preserved. All 4196 frames leave the mouth, body, fingers and 2816 unaffected vertices exactly unchanged. Native front and grounded-rear views show the revised silhouette. The rear view is not a frame-matched deep crouch comparison.
issues.next: Review remaining symbiote poses as their batches are completed; extend corrective policies only when supported by visual evidence. Retain deep-crouch coverage as a remaining targeted visual check.

issues.finding: Both source FBXs contain only the standard two arm chains. The 356 upper extra-arm vertices are weighted only to the collarbones; there are no independent extra-arm or extra-finger chains to retarget. The observed rest pose is authored source behavior, not dropped rig data.
issues.resolution: Preserve source hierarchy and weights as requested. Independent extra-arm animation would require an explicitly authorized change to that source rig/weight policy.

issues.finding: Weighted finger reach contracts under the fist policy, but several native captures show claw-like or incompletely closed free hands. Numeric contraction is not proof of a visually closed fist. The installed-231 audit passes 229 suits; Black Suit Swiney Girl and Devil Spider have no vertices predominantly weighted to the selected distal joints, so this metric cannot establish their closure. Those are coverage gaps, not proof that their preserved weights are damaged.
issues.next: Inspect and correct finger curl/orientation using representative hand geometry and native close views.

issues.finding: 6500 and 4511 runtime vertices exceed the current 4096-vertex, 18-packet renderer transport. Raising only metadata limits cannot support these assets.
issues.next: Extend actual rendering transport without losing triangles, normals, weights or materials, and test in the game.
